create_EQAEpisode: create an EQAEpisode with a QuestionData object containing question text and answer text
build_QuestionSensor: build a QuestionSensor that returns tokenized question observations from an EQAEpisode
implement_CorrectAnswer_measure: implement a CorrectAnswer measure that stores the episode answer token as a metric
implement_AnswerAccuracy_measure: implement an AnswerAccuracy measure that compares the agent answer against the correct answer token
run_EQATask: run an EQATask by navigating then submitting an AnswerAction with the predicted answer id
